scenes.title: HOOK
scenes.narration: Pre-workout. Magic in a scoop, or just *expensive coffee*?

scenes.title: MAIN EDUCATION - CAFFEINE
scenes.narration: The main thing doing the work is *caffeine*. Research shows it can boost strength and endurance a little.

scenes.title: MAIN EDUCATION - THE TINGLES
scenes.narration: That tingly feeling? That's *beta-alanine*. Harmless, just weird.

scenes.title: VISUAL DEMONSTRATION - DOSE
scenes.narration: You don't need a crazy dose. More stimulant doesn't mean more *gains*.

scenes.title: KEY TAKEAWAYS
scenes.narration: Skip it late in the day, or your *sleep* pays for it. Heart issues? Ask your doctor first.

scenes.title: ENDING
scenes.narration: Follow for more no-hype training science.
